assertions.assertion: Lists login_required, consent_required, interaction_required, account_selection_required, access_denied, temporarily_unavailable and unmet_authentication_requirements as errors returned to the client redirect_uri
assertions.rationale: List omits temporarily_unavailable and unmet_authentication_requirements and wrongly includes invalid_request, invalid_scope, unauthorized_client.

assertions.assertion: States errors like invalid_request, unauthorized_client, invalid_scope, invalid_request_object and server_error (and custom codes) show the error page
assertions.rationale: Wrongly says invalid_request, unauthorized_client, invalid_scope go to the client; error page examples differ.

assertions.assertion: States the set of safe codes cannot be configured
assertions.rationale: Says spec-mandated cases can't change but suggests ICustomAuthorizeRequestValidator; never states the set is fixed.

assertions.assertion: Explains untrusted requests are not redirected to avoid open redirects
assertions.rationale: Says redirecting on untrusted client/redirect_uri would risk an open redirect.
